chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj narrated; he said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “For the value of the pigeon, one dirham; for the chick, half a dirham; and for the egg, a quarter of a dirham.”

key_terms.الْحَمَامَةِ: a pigeon, for which compensation is due
key_terms.دِرْهَمٌ: a dirham, the unit of monetary compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation value for a pigeon, chick, and egg in the sanctuary according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the fixed compensation values for a pigeon, its chick, and its egg. It belongs to the legal rulings concerning hunting in the sanctuary, specifying the monetary liability due in such cases.
